scripts.typecheck: npm run build:agent-workflow && npm run build:knowledge-foundation && tsc --noEmit
scripts.pretest: npm run build:agent-workflow && npm run build:knowledge-foundation
scripts.build: npm run check:boundaries && npm run typecheck && vite build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts
scripts.test: node --import ./scripts/runtime/test-environment.mjs --import tsx --test packages/domain/test/*.test.ts packages/contracts/test/*.test.ts packages/assets/test/*.test.ts packages/adapters/storage/test/*.test.ts packages/runtime/test/*.test.ts apps/api/test/*.test.ts apps/worker/test/*.test.ts scripts/test/*.test.ts packages/video-analysis/test/*.test.ts packages/analysis/test/*.test.ts packages/adapters/analysis/test/*.test.ts apps/api/src/modules/analysis/*.test.ts apps/worker/src/handlers/analysis/*.test.ts apps/web/test/*.test.ts apps/shared/test/*.test.ts apps/web/test/*.test.tsx packages/knowledge/test/*.test.ts packages/adapters/knowledge/test/*.test.ts apps/api/src/modules/knowledge/*.test.ts apps/worker/src/handlers/knowledge/*.test.ts packages/discovery/test/*.test.ts packages/adapters/discovery/test/*.test.ts packages/creation/test/*.test.ts packages/knowledge-contracts/test/*.test.ts packages/knowledge-client/test/*.test.ts apps/knowledge-api/test/*.test.ts apps/knowledge-web/test/*.test.ts
scripts.build:knowledge-contracts: npm run build -w @commerce/contract-primitives && npm run build -w @commerce/knowledge-contracts
scripts.build:knowledge-client: npm run build:knowledge-contracts && npm run build -w @commerce/knowledge-client
scripts.build:knowledge-web: npm run build:knowledge-client && npm run build -w @commerce/knowledge-web
scripts.build:knowledge-server: npm run build:knowledge-contracts && npm run build:knowledge-core && npm run build -w @commerce/knowledge-application && npm run build -w @commerce/knowledge-service-adapter && npm run build -w @commerce/knowledge-api && npm run build -w @commerce/knowledge-worker
scripts.build:knowledge-adapters: npm run build:knowledge-client && npm run build -w @commerce/knowledge-document-adapter && npm run build -w @commerce/knowledge-commerce-adapter
scripts.build:knowledge-foundation: npm run build:knowledge-client && npm run build:knowledge-server && npm run build:knowledge-adapters
